text:
Leah: quick heads-up — onboarding hf/zephyr-1 hit tokenization drift. repo only has tokenizer_config.json, no tokenizer.json, runtime fell back to slow tokenizer and chat templates mis-parsed the <|system|> markers. anyone seen this exact combo before?
Omar: can you paste the artifact list + a snippet of tokenizer_config.json? helps to see if special tokens are present or if tokenizer_class is different.
Leah: sure — here’s the artifact tree we got from the model bundle:```
/opt/models/hf/zephyr-1/
  config.json
  merges.txt
  vocab.json
  tokenizer_config.json
  README.md
```
and tokenizer_config.json (redacted):```json
{
  "do_lower_case": false,
  "unk_token": "<|unk|>",
  "pad_token": "<|pad|>",
  "sep_token": "<|sep|>",
  "special_tokens_map": {"system": "<|system|>", "user": "<|user|>"}
}
```
No tokenizer.json present, so the "fast" tokenizers path never gets loaded. runtime picks HF slow fallback which tokenizes slightly differently (esp. for the chat template markers).
Mike: this is the HF conversion/packaging hole — when people export from some toolchains they only emit tokenizer_config.json + vocab/merges. Our model-converter should either synthesize tokenizer.json or reject the bundle with a clear error and a conversion hint.
Natalie: saw this manifest as an eval regression — +3-4% token count and prompt truncation for streaming tests. Proposal: add a converter flag `--emit-fast-json` and a CI check that verifies both tokenizer.json or a tokenizers serialization exist, or else fail. Also add a runtime warning metric if tokenizer.json missing so we can catch it in onboarding. @Omar @Mike what do you think? :thinking:
Omar: +1 on failing early. Failing earlier saves users. We should also add a small fallback generator that converts vocab/merges -> tokenizer.json using tokenizers library when possible, with a warning. Example command:```bash
python -c "from tokenizers import Tokenizer; t = Tokenizer.from_file('vocab.json') if False else None"  # pseudo
# real flow: use tokenizer models + normalizer to build and save tokenizer.json
```
Mike: agree. I'll add a guard in model-converter. Also add a unit test that loads the bundle with and without tokenizer.json and asserts token id parity for the special tokens.
ci-bot: PR created: https://git.redwood/example/pr/3421 — add converter guard + test (author: Natalie) :white_check_mark:
Avan: I'll hook up an alert for "tokenizer_mismatch" in console and schedule a hotfix deploy to dedicated tonight. once PR merges we can backfill failing onboarding runs. thanks y'all :thumbsup:
